inlines.v: TIN'GLE, verb intransitive [Latin tinnio.] 1. To feel a kind of thrilling sound. At which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle 1 Samuel 3:11. 2. To feel a sharp thrilling pain. The pale boy senator yet tingling stands. 3. To have a thrilling sensation, or a sharp slight penetrating sensation. They suck pollution through their tingling veins.
